label: 6.5 cm
note: Owner-uploaded reference images. Authoritative for construction/appearance; NOT usable as the tech-pack illustration (not line art, or shows multiple options).

references.evidence: Photograph 195x254, a dark styled still-life: a folded dark striped worsted trouser lying on a white shirt on an orange/wooden surface. At 14x the waistband detail is legible - a BELT LOOP crossing the band, and the WAISTBAND EXTENSION TAB projecting past the front edge with an angled/chamfered tip and a worked BUTTONHOLE near its end; two further buttons sit on a band lower in frame. The named garment part (extension tab with closure buttonhole) is genuinely present.

If this is a trouser waistband extension:

Finished waistband width: 4.0 cm
Extension length: 6.5 cm
Front drop: 2.2 cm
Curve radius: 4.5 cm
Fly shield width: 3.5 to 4.0 cm

This will maintain the same visual proportion as the original 13 cm pattern while reducing the extension to 6.5 cm.

references.evidence: Photograph 280x254 of a man wearing mid-grey worsted trousers with a white shirt and navy tie, both hands at the waist holding the fly open. The WAISTBAND EXTENSION TAB is clearly visible lying across the front carrying two buttons (one dark, one grey), with the belt loop to its left and the fly shield below showing its own worked buttonhole and closure hardware. Correct garment part, shown on a worn trouser at a legible angle - the better of the two refs for this option.
